## Checklist

- [ ] Branch is based on an up-to-date `main` and commits follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] New/changed behavior has tests where practical

- [ ] No secrets, credentials, DB files or generated artifacts are included

- [ ] Screenshots included for visible UI changes
